what_this_is: Serving provenance for the MATCHED Qwen 2D campaign (fourth review, point 1): both arms, same server, same effective configuration. The mixed-provenance first pass (continuous_synthesis_patch2d_compat-qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct_k3_7.json) is retained as an exploratory unmatched spot-check and is no longer the contrast the paper cites.

server.dtype: bf16 (no quantization flag; vllm serve default for this checkpoint)

model.downloaded: 2026-08-01 into a fresh Modal volume, so the served revision is the Hub's main at this sha

generation.server_defaults_applied: vLLM --generation-config auto reads the checkpoint's generation_config.json

caveats: n = 3 seeds per arm: an exploratory diagnostic, not a cross-family replication
sampling is the checkpoint's own generation_config, identical for BOTH arms; the client pins only max_tokens
the first-pass mixed file's top-level params name the HF router and n_seeds=10 from its original launch; it is superseded for the full-vs-incomplete contrast
